Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one individual square PNG ability icon for the Minecraft mod Mysteries Above. Reference: the user supplied example.jpg with chunky high quality pixel art magic icons in a thin square metal frame on black fields. Follow its pixel art direction closely. Deliver ONE icon filling the complete square image, no surrounding presentation, no sheet, no montage. Render as a disciplined 32 by 32 logical pixel sprite enlarged with exact nearest-neighbor square blocks, no subpixel details, no smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing. Consistent frame for this series: a straight 1 logical pixel wide desaturated silver gunmetal bevel exactly on the canvas edges, pale upper and left edges, charcoal lower and right edges, 1 pixel dark inset. Dark nearly black tinted interior. Main symbol occupies 24 of 32 logical pixels, strong distinct silhouette and enough negative space to read when reduced to 16x16. Rich pixel clusters, controlled local glow with solid stepped color ramps, no fuzzy bloom. No text, letters, numbers, runes resembling text, logos, watermark or UI outside icon. Avoid ornate corners, circles framing the whole icon, tiny scattered noise.
Ability: Fire of Light (Sun pathway, sun_fire_of_light). This is a stationary patch of holy golden flame burning on the ground and denying a corridor, NOT a projectile. Subject: a broad low bed of burning light with three irregular rising flame tongues, central tongue higher, ivory-white hot core at the bottom, stepped lemon yellow sides; a short dark stone ground ledge at the very bottom makes it anchored. Distinct asymmetric triangular upward silhouette. Palette exact anchor #FBE86B (251,232,107) with secondary #FFFF55, shadows deep ochre and warm near-black #100E08, sparse ivory #FFF9D8 hottest points. Predominantly luminous yellow gold, avoid orange-red fire. Keep the black negative gaps between the tongues visible.

Ability: Holy Oath (Sun pathway, sun_holy_oath). Actual mechanism: a priest swears an oath, their fists burn with holy light and every punch ignites enemies; sunlight reveals the caster through walls as the price. Main subject: ONE large clenched upraised fist seen in three-quarter view, wrist emerging from bottom right and knuckles diagonally up-left. A narrow straight column of pale sunlight from the top touches the knuckles. Several small squared golden flames cling to the fist, leaving dark gaps so the hand anatomy is clear. The fist is the main silhouette, do not depict a scroll or contract. Exact palette anchor #FBE86B plus #FFFF55, white ivory highlights #FFF9D8, ochre shadows and near-black #100E08. Same thin plain gunmetal square frame as the Fire of Light sample. Keep dramatic upper-left light, no orange-red.

Ability: Paper Figurine Substitution (Fool pathway, fool_paper_substitution). The magician folds paper dolls; a heavy incoming hit destroys one instead of the caster, whose body becomes a paper figure and escapes elsewhere. Main subject: ONE flat folded humanoid paper doll with square head, outstretched arms and separated legs. Doll tilted a little left, with an obvious diagonal tear breaking its torso into two pieces and exactly three large paper scraps separating to the lower right. The doll itself pale lavender paper, crease shadows dark purple, sharp ivory cut edges, bright violet magic escaping through the diagonal tear. Strong recognizable humanoid papercut silhouette, not a playing card, not a mask, not a skull. Exact pathway base #A26ED7 (162,110,215), accents violet #C895EF, tiny pink #FF55FF and pearl #F6E9FF, near-black purple #10091B interior. Plain thin silver gunmetal square frame identical to Fire of Light. No other symbol.

Ability: Instant Step / Blink (Door pathway, door_blink). Actual mechanic: two pale doorways joined by a folded passage; the Traveller rushes through successive arch outlines in the direction of gaze. Main subject: ONE dominant luminous angular doorway in the left foreground, tall rectangular opening with a stepped rounded arch top, dark hollow center, viewed obliquely; a second smaller doorway recedes towards upper right. ONE short broad white-cyan movement streak curves through them, communicating a fast spatial step. Two distinct arch outlines only, strong negative space inside. NOT a key, circular portal, eye, generic spiral or human portrait. Exact base #6AE6F7 (106,230,247), secondary #55FFFF, pale ice highlights #E2FDFF, deep teal shadows and near-black #071318. Same plain thin gunmetal square frame as Fire of Light. Doorways should read first, moving corridor second.

Ability: Wind Blades (Tyrant pathway, tyrant_windblades). Actual mechanic compresses air into a cutting gust; crouching releases a three-blade fan. Subject: exactly THREE separate scythe-shaped curved cutting gusts fanning diagonally from bottom-left towards upper-right, largest in center, two smaller around it, separated by broad black channels. Each blade has a thick bright leading edge and a tapering stepped blue trailing side; sparse short straight speed marks behind lower-left tips. They are magical compressed AIR, not metal knives, swords, water droplets, lightning bolts or a vortex. Strong open fan silhouette. Exact base #4673C7 (70,115,199) must dominate, secondary subdued #00AAAA, pale icy blue highlights #DCEFFF, near-black navy #080D1A interior. Keep cyan minimal so Tyrant stays visibly cobalt compared to Door. Same thin plain silver gunmetal frame as Fire of Light.
